title: Manga Creator Kyō Yoneshiro Launches New Manga Based on Junichirō Tanizaki's Naomi Novel
content: This year's 35th issue of Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine announced on Monday that manga creator Kyō Yoneshiro will launch a new manga titled Netsuzō: Chijin no Ai (Fabrication: A Fool's Love), based on Junichirō Tanizaki 's 1924 novel Chijin no Ai (published in English under the title Naomi ) in the…
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of 2026 Finally Begins Its Main Story With a Twist No One Saw Coming
content: The Summer of 2026 continues to get more exciting as currently airing anime release new episodes every week, and one of Crunchyroll ‘s darkest anime of the year may have just kicked off an intriguing journey with a twist no one saw coming.
author: ComicBook

title: Millennium Family Anime Adaptation Announced
content: An anime adaptation of the Millennium Family manga has been announced on Monday. A teaser visual and trailer were released along with information about the staff and main cast. The release date has not been revealed yet.
author: Anime Corner

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Anime's 'Episode of Savanaclaw' Debuts in December
content: Disney+ revealed the teaser visual and December exclusive streaming debut on the service of Episode of Savanaclaw , the second season for the Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation series (written as Twisted Wonderland), on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Manga Gets 5th Stage Play in November
content: The official website for the stage plays of Gege Akutami 's Jujutsu Kaisen manga announced on Monday a new stage play titled Butai Jujutsu Kaisen -Shibuya Jihen Zenpen- (Stage Jujutsu Kaisen -Shibuya Incident Part 1-), which will run on November 14-23 at Shibuya LOVEZ in Tokyo, and on November 28-29 at Sky Theater MBS…
author: ANN

title: Millennium Family Manga Gets Anime
content: Shōnengahōsha announced on Monday that Sho Kasugai 's Millennium Family ( Odoru Sennen Kazoku ) manga is inspiring a television anime adaptation. The anime will air on TBS and other stations, but the announcement did not reveal the debut date for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Drawn and Quarterly Licenses Marmalade Princess, Lady Hokusai Manga
content: Publisher Drawn & Quarterly announced during a panel at San Diego Comic-Con on Saturday that it has licensed Shigeo Ito 's Marmalade Princess manga and Hinako Sugiura 's Miss Hokusai manga (under the title Lady Hokusai ), and will release them in spring and fall 2027, respectively.
author: ANN

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 2 Game's Switch 2 Edition Trailer Reveals Xenosaga's Momo
content: Nintendo began streaming a new overview trailer for the Switch 2 Edition of the Xenoblade Chronicles 2 game on Friday. The video reveals that the new edition of the game will add the character Momo from Xenosaga as a Rare Blade.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Streams Gintama the Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames on August 27
content: Netflix announced on Sunday that it will stream Gintama: The Movie 2026: Yoshiwara in Flames ( Shin-Gekijōban Gintama: Yoshiwara Daienjō ), the new compilation film for the anime based on Hideaki Sorachi 's Gintama manga, starting on August 27. The film opened in Japan on February 13.
author: ANN

title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku: Eureka Evrika' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hiro Yuuki 's Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku ( 20th Century Electricity Catalog ) light novel revealed a supporting pair of cast and an episode 4 visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime premiered on July 5 at 11:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList
